Stop! Taurus, the cosmos flashes an urgent signal just for you.

Venus, your ruling planet, is in your 2nd House of Resources trine Mars in your 6th House of Work, boosting earnings through steady effort.

This earthy alignment turns practical ideas into profit, especially when you budget with patience.

Blessing: an unexpected financial refund or rebate may appear — check your mail.
